The description agrees with a standard chair, so it's a clerical error, not a clinical one. Pre-screen: no sentence addresses criterion B (a cane or walker can't resolve it); C (home can accommodate a wheelchair). CORRECTION_REQUESTED, loop 1 of 2.

events.title: Ask for a corrected code and the missing criteria
events.detail: The fix is accepted "Our EHR defaults to K0003, so I'll fix that on the order.". Documentation questions go to the clinician. The engine named the criteria and stopped there. It wrote no clinical text (D8).

events.title: Signed order passes validation
events.detail: 6 of 6 order elements. HCPCS K0001. Quantity 1. Dated on or after the visit. VALIDATED. The pre-screen finds no gaps. Lincoln Park DME Services is committed, so the order, her name and her MBI go to Lincoln Park DME Services only (D3).

events.title: Lincoln Park DME Services confirms
events.detail: Supplier CONFIRMED: it has the order "Yep, got the order and the note, both came through by fax this morning.", eligibility is clean "Eligibility's clean too, no other wheelchair on file for her, and she's Original Medicare.", and a date is set "Yep, I can hold Monday, one to four for her.". Order DOCS_OK. Two of three join inputs are ready. Next, Eleanor must approve the supplier and window (D10).

events.title: Eleanor approves Lincoln Park DME Services and the window
events.detail: Consent "That's fine with me, as long as they can get it up to my apartment." and window "That's fine. Monday works." are quoted, so WINDOW_CONFIRMED. The join fires and the case is DELIVERY_SCHEDULED.

events.title: Nobody came
events.detail: "No. Nobody came with the chair this afternoon.": the window was missed, so the patient goes back to INFORMED. Check with the supplier now. The ghost threshold is Tue Nov 10 17:00.

events.title: Lincoln Park DME Services doesn't answer
events.detail: No answer. Retry Tue Nov 10 09:00.

events.title: Lincoln Park DME Services doesn't answer
events.detail: Miss 2 since the promised date. Any voicemail has a callback number and an order reference, and no health details (D3).

events.title: Hedge: check the backup before the ghost threshold
events.detail: Lincoln Park DME Services missed and isn't answering, so the backup is checked before the threshold. Earliest: "the earliest we'd be able to start is Thursday morning". Her name isn't shared. Prairie State Medical Supply is QUALIFIED.

events.title: Lincoln Park DME Services marked GHOSTED
events.detail: Promised date +1 business day, no delivery, so GHOSTED. The case drops back to OPEN. Prairie State Medical Supply is next, but Eleanor has to approve the switch before her details go anywhere (D3, D10). The validated order is reused, with no new request to the doctor (D5).

events.title: Eleanor raises a cost concern
events.detail: cost_concern is true with a quote ("I can't take on another bill every month."), so PATIENT_COST_CONCERN. The patient thread stops. The join can't fire without her consent, so the case is BLOCKED_ON_HUMAN. The supplier and order threads keep running. The engine didn't try to talk her into it.

events.title: Care advocate decides: Proceed and start a QMB application
events.detail: A typed decision came back on PATIENT_COST_CONCERN. Note: Called Eleanor for 25 minutes. Walked through the $72 total; the surgery bill is separate. Income is about $1,250 a month, so she likely qualifies for QMB. Started the application. She wants the chair and approves the next supplier. The engine resumes the patient thread and asks her again.

events.title: Eleanor approves Prairie State Medical Supply and the window
events.detail: Consent "Prairie State, yes, that's fine with me." and window "Yes, Thursday works for me." are quoted, so WINDOW_CONFIRMED.

events.title: Engine resumes: order to Prairie State Medical Supply
events.detail: With her consent, the order, her name and her MBI may go to Prairie State Medical Supply (D3). Its earlier quote "Yes, if they send the order, we'll accept it." counts as accepting the referral, so COMMITTED. The validated order is re-sent as is (D5).

events.title: Prairie State Medical Supply: confirmation incomplete
events.detail: No verified quote for docs_sufficient. One clarifying call (§10).

events.title: Prairie State Medical Supply confirms
events.detail: Supplier CONFIRMED: it has the order "we got it all. Her signed order, her Medicare number and the visit note came in by fax this morning.", eligibility is clean "Yes, it came back clean.", and a date is set "Tomorrow, Friday, between nine and twelve.". Order DOCS_OK. Her window was already approved, so the join fires: DELIVERY_SCHEDULED.

events.title: It's here
events.detail: "Yes, it's here.": DELIVERY_VERIFIED from her side. The supplier's proof of delivery is still needed (D11).

events.title: Proof of delivery and billing code
events.detail: Proof of delivery "Rosa signed the delivery ticket." and her account agree (D11). The billed code "We're billing K0001 with the RR and KH modifiers" matches the validated order. DELIVERED.

events.title: Case closed
events.detail: The billed code matches the order. CLOSED after 9 business days (holidays excluded), with 1 escalation.
